title: 2026 UK ETS SAF eligible-fuel scope alignment QA

sources.title: UK ETS treatment of SAF consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel

facts.source_fact: Under current UK ETS rules, only biofuels are eligible for SAF emissions-reduction claims.
Current UK ETS eligibility is linked to the RTFO framework.
RCFs are currently treated as fossil kerosene for UK ETS emissions-reduction claims.
PtL fuels are currently treated as fossil kerosene for UK ETS emissions-reduction claims.
RCFs and PtL are eligible under the SAF Mandate.
The Authority is consulting on expanding eligible fuel types beyond biofuels.
Alignment with SAF Mandate fuel eligibility could bring RCFs into UK ETS eligibility.
Alignment with SAF Mandate fuel eligibility could bring PtL into UK ETS eligibility.
Alignment could also cause crop-based SAF that is eligible under current RTFO-linked rules to cease being eligible if not eligible under the SAF Mandate.
These changes are consultation options and are not current UK ETS law.
